epic.title: EPIC - UP Analytics: Global Analytics Core v3
epic.shortTitle: UP Analytics: Global Analytics Core v3
epic.functionalNeed:
**Global Analytics Core v3** continues the evolution of the Onclusive Analytics module started in [UP-1739] (Global Analytics Core v2), focused this round on information-architecture cleanup and consistency work across Core and Premium tiers.

Tighten up the Analytics experience so navigation, entry points, and functionality behave consistently regardless of tier - removing duplicate or diverging paths that accumulated as Premium and Core features evolved separately.
scope: Stories under this epic will be scoped and added incrementally as this work is planned. First up: consolidating the Analytics entry point for Core users under Measure (removing the duplicate "Chart Analytics" tab under Mention).

stories.title: UP Analytics Core Module - Volume by Country map chart with country drill-down to Related Mentions

userStory.want: to see my mention volume on a world map, and click a country to see the mentions behind it
userStory.so: I can understand where my coverage comes from geographically and investigate a specific market in one click

acceptanceCriteria.title: Adding the chart
acceptanceCriteria.given: I open the Add chart modal on the Coverage tab
acceptanceCriteria.when: I select the Volume metric
acceptanceCriteria.then: I see a Map option under "Visualise as"; selecting it shows Volume by Country as the Group by option, with a live map preview; the default size is M

acceptanceCriteria.title: Map display
acceptanceCriteria.given: the chart is on my dashboard
acceptanceCriteria.when: it loads
acceptanceCriteria.then: I see a world map where each country with mentions is shaded on a sequential blue scale (light = low volume, dark = high volume); countries with no mentions are shown in neutral grey; a colour legend shows the volume scale; I can zoom in/out with the +/− controls

acceptanceCriteria.title: Country tooltip
acceptanceCriteria.given: I hover a country with mentions
acceptanceCriteria.when: the tooltip appears
acceptanceCriteria.then: it shows:

acceptanceCriteria.title: Filters and date range
acceptanceCriteria.given: the chart is on my dashboard
acceptanceCriteria.when: I change the saved search, date range or dashboard filters (media type, tags, entities…)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the map and tooltip values refresh to reflect the new selection; if no mentions match, the standard "No data found" empty state is shown

acceptanceCriteria.title: Map loading and errors
acceptanceCriteria.given: the map shapes fail to load
acceptanceCriteria.then: a "Couldn't load the map" message with a Retry action is displayed (no blank chart)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Clicking a country
acceptanceCriteria.given: I am viewing the Volume by Country chart
acceptanceCriteria.when: I click a country that has mentions
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Related Mentions modal opens with the title "Related Mentions - Volume by Country · {Country}"; only mentions from that country are listed; the active saved search, date range and dashboard filters still apply

acceptanceCriteria.title: Clicking a country without mentions
acceptanceCriteria.given: a country is shown in grey (no mentions)
acceptanceCriteria.when: I click it
acceptanceCriteria.then: nothing happens (no modal opens)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Clicking outside a country
acceptanceCriteria.given: I am viewing the chart
acceptanceCriteria.when: I click the chart card outside the map shapes
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Related Mentions modal opens unfiltered by country (current behaviour for all charts)

stories.title: UP Analytics Core Module - Edit chart subheader alongside chart title

userStory.want: to edit a chart's subheader (the description line under the chart title) in the same place I rename the chart
userStory.so: I can fix typos or tailor the subheader to my audience without recreating the chart

acceptanceCriteria.title: Menu entry
acceptanceCriteria.given: I am on an Analytics dashboard (Core or Premium) and not in read-only mode
acceptanceCriteria.when: I open the ⋯ menu on a chart card
acceptanceCriteria.then: I see an Edit title option (replacing "Rename")

acceptanceCriteria.title: Inline editing of title and subheader
acceptanceCriteria.given: I click Edit title
acceptanceCriteria.when: the chart header switches to edit mode
acceptanceCriteria.then: I see two inputs: the chart title (pre-filled) and the subheader (pre-filled with the current subheader, placeholder "Subheader (optional)"); I can Save (✓ or Enter) or Cancel (✕ or Esc)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Saving changes
acceptanceCriteria.given: I have edited the title and/or subheader
acceptanceCriteria.when: I save
acceptanceCriteria.then: both the new title and subheader are displayed on the chart card; they persist after switching dashboard tabs, switching dashboards, navigating to GEO and back, or reloading the page

acceptanceCriteria.title: Clearing the subheader
acceptanceCriteria.given: I clear the subheader input
acceptanceCriteria.when: I save
acceptanceCriteria.then: the chart is displayed with the title only (no subheader line)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Validation
acceptanceCriteria.given: the title input is empty
acceptanceCriteria.when: I try to save
acceptanceCriteria.then: no changes are applied and the previous title and subheader are kept

acceptanceCriteria.title: Default subheader
acceptanceCriteria.given: I have never edited a chart's subheader
acceptanceCriteria.when: I view the chart
acceptanceCriteria.then: the default subheader from the chart definition is shown (including the comparison-mode variant where applicable)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Read-only permalinks
acceptanceCriteria.given: I am viewing a read-only dashboard snapshot
acceptanceCriteria.when: I view a chart card
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Edit title option is not available, and the customised title/subheader are displayed

acceptanceCriteria.title: Reports
acceptanceCriteria.given: I have customised a chart's subheader
acceptanceCriteria.when: I create a report from the dashboard
acceptanceCriteria.then: the chart is included with its customised title (subheader handling in reports TBD)

stories.title: UP Analytics Core Module - Refine "Add Chart" Flow: Metric Tab Exclusivity, Global Search & Chart Reorganization

userStory.as: PR & Communications Manager using the Analytics Core Module
userStory.want: the "Add Chart" modal to have cleanly categorized metrics, exclusive tab placements, and a global metric search across both tabs
userStory.so: I can intuitively locate, search, and add the exact charts I need without ambiguity or navigating back and forth between tabs

acceptanceCriteria.title: Single-Tab Metric Assignment
acceptanceCriteria.given: I open the "Add Chart" modal
acceptanceCriteria.when: I browse through the Coverage and Impact tabs
acceptanceCriteria.then: each metric and chart type must appear in strictly one tab; no chart or metric should be duplicated across both tabs

acceptanceCriteria.title: Search Metrics Across Both Tabs
acceptanceCriteria.given: I am in the "Add Chart" modal on either tab (Coverage or Impact)
acceptanceCriteria.when: I type a search query in the search bar (e.g., "Reach" or "Sentiment")
acceptanceCriteria.then: the search results should return matching metrics and charts from both Coverage and Impact tabs; search results should clearly indicate which tab each metric belongs to

acceptanceCriteria.title: Select Search Result from Alternative Tab
acceptanceCriteria.given: I am viewing search results matching a metric from the other tab (e.g., searching for an Impact metric while on the Coverage tab)
acceptanceCriteria.when: I select the chart card from the search results
acceptanceCriteria.then: the chart preview panel opens showing the chart configuration; the preview clearly indicates the destination tab where the chart will be added

acceptanceCriteria.title: Consolidate Reach Charts Under Impact Tab
acceptanceCriteria.given: I am browsing the "Add Chart" modal
acceptanceCriteria.when: I switch to the Impact tab
acceptanceCriteria.then: all Reach metric charts (e.g., Reach trend) must be grouped under the Reach category within the Impact tab; all charts related to reach should reside in the Impact tab of the dashboard

stories.title: UP Analytics Core Module - API & Pipeline for CM Saved Searches & Results

userStory.as: PR & Communications Manager with access to the Analytics Module – Core
userStory.want: the system to pull all my saved custom searches and chart settings via API from Critical Mention
userStory.so: my charts in Analytics automatically match my brand’s color scheme without manual reconfiguration

acceptanceCriteria.title: Pull Saved Searches via API
acceptanceCriteria.feature: Import Saved Searches and Articles via API
acceptanceCriteria.given: I have saved searches configured in Critical Mention
acceptanceCriteria.when: I access the Analytics Module
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system should retrieve the list of saved searches via a secure API call; display them in the appropriate dashboard

acceptanceCriteria.title: Pull Underlying Articles for Each Saved Search
acceptanceCriteria.feature: Import Saved Searches and Articles via API
acceptanceCriteria.given: saved searches are retrieved
acceptanceCriteria.when: I select or load a saved search in Analytics
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system should also pull the full list of associated articles; those articles should populate the relevant charts, dashboards, and reports.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Automatic Sync and Refresh
acceptanceCriteria.feature: Import Saved Searches and Articles via API
acceptanceCriteria.given: saved searches or articles are updated in Critical Mention
acceptanceCriteria.when: I access Analytics or manually refresh
acceptanceCriteria.then: the changes should reflect automatically in Analytics via the API integration.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Error Handling and Access Control
acceptanceCriteria.feature: Import Saved Searches and Articles via API
acceptanceCriteria.given: there is a failure to retrieve saved searches or articles via the API
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system should display a clear error message; ensure that only users with appropriate access can view the data.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Import Saved Dashboards via API
acceptanceCriteria.given: I have saved dashboards configured in Critical Mention
acceptanceCriteria.when: I access the Analytics Module for the first time or trigger a sync
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system should retrieve all saved dashboards via a secure API call; display them in my Analytics dashboard library, preserving their original layout and widget configuration.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Preserve Dashboard Configuration and Chart Settings
acceptanceCriteria.given: a saved dashboard is imported from Critical Mention
acceptanceCriteria.when: the dashboard is rendered in Analytics
acceptanceCriteria.then: all chart types, filters, date ranges, and saved search associations should be preserved; the dashboard should display data consistent with the original Critical Mention configuration.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Partial Import and Error Handling
acceptanceCriteria.given: one or more dashboards or templates fail to import due to API errors or incompatible configurations
acceptanceCriteria.when: the import process completes
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system should display a summary of successfully imported and failed items; provide actionable error messages so the user can resolve issues manually.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Sync User Roles from Critical Mention
acceptanceCriteria.given: users have assigned roles such as Admin, Editor, or Viewer in Critical Mention
acceptanceCriteria.when: they access the Analytics Module
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system should automatically retrieve and apply their corresponding roles via the API; grant or restrict access to features based on those roles.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Role Change Propagation
acceptanceCriteria.given: an Admin updates a user's role in the Analytics Module or Critical Mention
acceptanceCriteria.when: the change is saved
acceptanceCriteria.then: the updated permissions should take effect immediately upon the user's next action or page refresh; the user should be notified of any significant access changes.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Access Revocation and Session Handling
acceptanceCriteria.given: a user's access is revoked by an Admin
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user is currently active in the Analytics Module
acceptanceCriteria.then: their session should be terminated or restricted within a defined timeout period; they should be redirected to an appropriate access-denied or logout page.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Sync Filtering Rules via API
acceptanceCriteria.given: I have specific filtering rules, such as keyword exclusions or source filters, set up in Critical Mention
acceptanceCriteria.when: I access the Analytics Module
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system should retrieve these rules via API; apply them to the data being processed for Analytics charts and dashboards.

acceptanceCriteria.title: Real-time Filter Updates
acceptanceCriteria.given: a filter or filtering rule is modified in Critical Mention
acceptanceCriteria.when: I refresh the Analytics dashboard
acceptanceCriteria.then: the updated filtering rules should be applied immediately to the displayed data.
